---
title: "Explorable: Friendship Paradox vs. γ"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

Drag γ to change how heavy-tailed the degree distribution is, then watch the friendship
paradox strengthen or collapse. Each node's degree is sampled from a power law with that γ,
then wired up into a real graph via the configuration model (random stub-pairing) — nothing
here is precomputed, it's regenerated live in your browser. Companion piece to [Week 2's
friendship-paradox post](/posts/2026-week2-friendship-paradox/).

```{=html}

  <div class="controls">

      <div class="stat"><span class="label">&lt;k_nn&gt;</span><span class="value" id="stat-knn">-</span></div>

        87% of characters have friends more popular than they are. Its own CCDF regression

<script>
(function () {
  const N = 303;
  const canvas = document.getElementById("scatter-canvas");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const slider = document.getElementById("gamma-slider");
  const gammaLabel = document.getElementById("gamma-value");
  const rerollBtn = document.getElementById("reroll-btn");

  function sampleDegreeSequence(gamma, n) {
    const xmin = 1;
    const cap = n - 1;
    const degs = new Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const r = Math.random();
      let d = xmin * Math.pow(1 - r, -1 / (gamma - 1));
      d = Math.round(d);
      if (d < 1) d = 1;
      if (d > cap) d = cap;
      degs[i] = d;
    }
    let sum = degs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    if (sum % 2 === 1) {
      degs[0] += 1;
    }
    return degs;
  }

  function shuffle(arr) {
    for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
    }
    return arr;
  }

  // Configuration model: build a stub list from the degree sequence, shuffle it,
  // pair consecutive stubs into edges. Self-loops and repeated pairs can occur
  // (as in any configuration model) - we dedupe them away when building the
  // adjacency sets below, same as the real post drops self-loops.
  function buildConfigModelGraph(degs) {
    const stubs = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < degs.length; i++) {
      for (let k = 0; k < degs[i]; k++) stubs.push(i);
    }
    shuffle(stubs);
    const adj = Array.from({ length: degs.length }, () => new Set());
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < stubs.length; i += 2) {
      const a = stubs[i], b = stubs[i + 1];
      if (a === b) continue; // drop self-loops
      adj[a].add(b);
      adj[b].add(a);
    }
    return adj;
  }

  function render(gamma) {
    gammaLabel.textContent = gamma.toFixed(2);

    const targetDegs = sampleDegreeSequence(gamma, N);
    const adj = buildConfigModelGraph(targetDegs);
    const degree = adj.map((s) => s.size);

    let m = 0;
    for (const d of degree) m += d;
    m = m / 2;

    const ownDeg = [];
    const nbrMeanDeg = [];
    let paradoxCount = 0;
    let connectedCount = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      if (adj[i].size === 0) continue;
      connectedCount++;
      let sum = 0;
      for (const nb of adj[i]) sum += degree[nb];
      const meanNbr = sum / adj[i].size;
      ownDeg.push(degree[i]);
      nbrMeanDeg.push(meanNbr);
      if (meanNbr > degree[i]) paradoxCount++;
    }

    const meanK = degree.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / N;
    const meanK2 = degree.reduce((a, b) => a + b * b, 0) / N;
    const knn = meanK2 / meanK;
    const ratio = knn / meanK;

    document.getElementById("stat-n").textContent = N;
    document.getElementById("stat-m").textContent = Math.round(m);
    document.getElementById("stat-k").textContent = meanK.toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById("stat-knn").textContent = knn.toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById("stat-ratio").textContent = ratio.toFixed(2) + "x";
    document.getElementById("stat-frac").textContent =
      ((paradoxCount / connectedCount) * 100).toFixed(0) + "%";

    drawScatter(ownDeg, nbrMeanDeg);
  }

  function drawScatter(ownDeg, nbrMeanDeg) {
    const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height;
    const pad = 40;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

    const maxVal = Math.max(1, ...ownDeg, ...nbrMeanDeg) * 1.3;
    const minVal = 0.8;
    const logMin = Math.log10(minVal), logMax = Math.log10(maxVal);

    function xPix(v) {
      return pad + ((Math.log10(Math.max(v, minVal)) - logMin) / (logMax - logMin)) * (w - 2 * pad);
    }
    function yPix(v) {
      return h - pad - ((Math.log10(Math.max(v, minVal)) - logMin) / (logMax - logMin)) * (h - 2 * pad);
    }

    // axes
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ccc";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(pad, pad, w - 2 * pad, h - 2 * pad);

    // diagonal (friends = you)
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#999";
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xPix(minVal), yPix(minVal));
    ctx.lineTo(xPix(maxVal), yPix(maxVal));
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // points
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(76, 114, 176, 0.55)";
    for (let i = 0; i < ownDeg.length; i++) {
      const x = xPix(ownDeg[i]);
      const y = yPix(nbrMeanDeg[i]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, 3, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = "#555";
    ctx.font = "12px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("own degree →", w / 2 - 30, h - 12);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(14, h / 2 + 30);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.fillText("mean friend degree →", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  slider.addEventListener("input", () => render(parseFloat(slider.value)));
  rerollBtn.addEventListener("click", () => render(parseFloat(slider.value)));

  render(parseFloat(slider.value));
})();
</script>
```
